name: ZaoSeq Bopomofo v0.2 Round 2 selection plan
scope: Daily Corpus Round 2 + Production Lexicon Cleanup (v0.2 development). Written and committed before any Round 2 experiment; it must not change after results are seen.
never_used_for_selection: v0.1 TEST-EVERYDAY / TEST-GOV / TYPO-REFERENCE-v0 (leakage exclusion and historical reference only)
teacher window size K (production teacher stays K=4)
memory / runtime representation (must be exactly equivalent; not a selection axis)

references.baseline: frozen V0 (benchmarks/frozen/V0.json): GeneralCorpusLanguageModel + builtin lexicon, beam 48, nbest 20
references.teacher: frozen fine-tuned Laya (benchmarks/frozen/FINAL.json), engine.build_production_ranker, K=4 families
references.reference_values: measured in the same run as the candidates (V0 decoder and V0 + frozen teacher on both DEV sets)

rule.name: production_eligibility
rule.requirement: Every daily source used by the config (LM and lexicon) passes LicenseGate with Purpose.PRODUCTION (status APPROVED, approval_scope production, all rights fields determined, SHA-256 verified). Configs that use HOLD or dev_experiment sources (e.g. OASST1) are reported as diagnostics and can never be selected.

rule.name: regression_gates
rule.tests: full pytest suite and ruff pass; V0.json and FINAL.json verify
rule.definition: drop = reference value - candidate value on GOV-DEV (absolute, fraction of 400 items); a config fails if either drop is > 0.02

rule.name: primary
rule.metric: coverage_dev frozen-teacher Top-1 (K=4) on the config's candidate list

rule.name: tie_break
rule.tie_set: all gate-passing configs whose primary is within 1 sentence (<= 1/300) of the best primary

order.metric: coverage_dev teacher correct_to_wrong vs the V0 teacher
incremental RSS MB of the runtime artifacts
artifact size MB (daily LM + compact lexicon)

rule.comparison: lexicographic; each criterion compares exact values rounded to 6 decimals

candidates.R0: previous Cartesian product of CNS readings (<= 4 combinations). Diagnostic only, never selectable.
candidates.R1: unambiguous-only: every character has exactly one CNS reading; the word gets that single reading sequence.
candidates.R2: known-word-reading: characters with several CNS readings are allowed only inside a span covered by a builtin multi-character word that has exactly one explicit reading (longest match); all other characters must have exactly one CNS reading.
candidates.R3: bounded-reading: R2 plus builtin single-character rows that list exactly one explicit reading. Still one reading sequence per word; never a Cartesian product.

stages.common: Han-only 2..4 characters inside Han runs, not already a builtin word, fragment share < 0.9 (a single one-character extension covering >= 90% of occurrences marks a fragment)

candidates.L1: government + daily: pooled frequency >= 2 per million, documents >= 2
candidates.L2: daily-only: counts from production daily sources only; daily count >= 3, daily documents >= 3, daily PMI >= 3
candidates.L3: daily-supported: L1 words that also occur in >= 2 daily documents
candidates.L4: domain-ratio filtered: L1 minus words whose normalised-rate concentration (max_d r_d / sum_d r_d over the 4 government domains and daily, r_d = count_d / tokens_d) is >= 0.8 in a government domain, minus words with numeral-adjacent occurrence share >= 0.5
candidates.L5: doc-frequency filtered: L1 with documents >= 5 and distinct sources >= 3

stages.axis: lexical prior (weight mapping); every mapping clipped to [3, 200]

candidates.raw: w = 10 * f / median(f), f = pooled relative frequency
candidates.doc: w = 10 * df / median(df), df = document count
candidates.daily_only: w = 10 * f_daily / median(f_daily over words with f_daily > 0); words with f_daily = 0 get 3
candidates.interpolated: w = 10 * f / median(f), f = 0.25 * P_daily + 0.75 * sum_d w_d * P_d (GENERAL domain weights)
candidates.rank_bucket: by pooled f among eligible words: top 10% -> 50, next 20% -> 20, next 40% -> 10, bottom 30% -> 3

stages.note: 0.0 = frozen V0 language model with the clean lexicon

stages.axis: corpus ablation (only when two or more production-approved daily sources exist)
stages.candidates: each production-approved daily source alone, then all production-approved sources together; lexicon rebuilt from the same sources; stage-4 weight
stages.note: sources approved during this round only enter here; stages 1-4 use the sources approved when this plan was frozen (tatoeba_cmn_hant)

final_selection: Apply the rule to every production-eligible config evaluated in stages 1-5 plus A (V0). The winner of each stage fixes that axis for the next stage.
diagnostics_not_selectable: OASST1 or any dev_experiment / HOLD source
teacher K = 8 re-check (only if the candidate distribution changes substantially)
false_competitor_definition: a derived (text, reading) whose reading is not supported by the reading policy's evidence and that shares its reading sequence with a different lexicon word of the same length
